summary: Missing marker, missing/malformed fence, invalid JSON, and raw Markdown masquerading as .table.md have distinct handler symptoms.
Tokenizer/parser/evaluator expose position-bearing syntax errors, type errors, and runtime failures; renderer persists empty and displays em dash on error.
CSV parsing supports quoted commas but splits physical lines first, so quoted multiline fields are unsafe; jagged rows and unmatched quotes are tolerated.
Plugin shallowly validates roots and does not reject duplicate IDs, missing cell keys, policy fields, or unknown versions; AI should validate more strictly.
Do not treat the displayed em dash, policy field, unknown version acceptance, or ignored view fields as evidence of a complete/valid data model.
